vectors.name: formats-toml/temporal-writing/time-with-seconds
vectors.comment: E-37: TOML has a native literal for this value, written unaltered and with its seconds; nothing is reported. (The label is `a b` so that every writer quotes the key.)

vectors.name: formats-toml/temporal-writing/time-with-offset
vectors.comment: E-37: TOML has no time-of-day literal with an offset, so the value is written as a quoted ISO-8601 string with its seconds and offset, and reported. It is not converted, dropped, or a crash.
